text:
alex_sales: Heads up -- MeadowPay POC showing worse-than-expected TTFT during their morning spike. Customers complaining about slow UX.

tori_se: Can you share a recent request_id and the config on their dedicated pool?

alex_sales: Sure -- rq=mp_20260304_11. Pool `meadow-ded` running `redwood-3b-8bit-q`, concurrency=2, batch_window_ms=10, prefetch=off. Traffic shape: lots of tiny prompts (1-3 tokens) at 120 req/min bursts.

ops-bot: log excerpt for mp_20260304_11:
[2026-03-04T08:12:05Z] rq=mp_20260304_11 pool=meadow-ded model=redwood-3b-8bit-q seq_len=2 batch_size=1 batch_window_ms=10 kv_cache_hit=false latency_first_token_ms=980

ryan_infra: With concurrency=2 and no prefetch those bursts will get serialized small batches and suffer scheduler overhead. Also check if `batch_scheduler_pack_threshold` was lowered by their infra team.

tori_se: Do we have heatmap of kv_cache_hit by client_prefix?

ops-bot: kv cache heatmap (1h): top-5 prefixes cover 18% of requests, long tail across thousands of prefixes.

ola_runtime: Short explanation: our kernel path for tiny prompts is amortized only when KV entries are reused or when batch_size>1. If both are false you pay the cold-model path each time. Two safe mitigations: enable conservative prefetch limited to top prefixes OR raise concurrency/batch_window to allow small batches to form.

leah_support: Customer had asked not to preload due to memory limits on their end. Can we do prefix-scoped prefetching to respect memory?

ryan_infra: Yes -- config supports `prefetch_mode=top_k_prefixes` and `prefetch_k=50`. That way we only keep most frequent prefixes warmed. Command (infra):
redwoodctl update-pool meadow-ded --set prefetch=true --set prefetch_mode=top_k_prefixes --set prefetch_k=50 --set prefetch_ttl=90

nate_pricing: If they prefer not to change pool config we can also offer a temporary higher-concurrency trial (extra nodes) during business hours. We can price it as a 48-hour burst with a capped spend.

claire_pm: Also flagged: they submitted an enterprise questionnaire asking about audit logs retention and whether enabling prefetch affects encrypted data handling. Any quick answer?

ola_runtime: Prefetch only caches KV frames (model-side activation state), not raw prompt text. With KMS integration, customer keys remain in their KMS and logs redact sensitive fields. Prefetching doesn't change residency or KMS behavior.

alex_sales: Can infra try a conservative config in staging and return numbers within 20m? Call with customer at 10:30 PT.

ryan_infra: On it. Will run two quick experiments in staging: A) prefetched top50 prefixes, B) bump concurrency to 5 and batch_window_ms=12 (to allow some packing).

ops-bot: staging experiment A applied to meadow-ded-staging: prefetch=top50, ttl=90. Test sample (2m): median_latency_first_token_ms=160 kv_cache_hit_rate=74%

ops-bot: staging experiment B applied to meadow-ded-staging-b: concurrency=5 batch_window_ms=12. Test sample (2m): median_latency_first_token_ms=210 kv_cache_hit_rate=12%

tori_se: Interesting -- A (prefetch top50) looks much better. B didn't help because the workload is extremely high-cardinality leading to tiny batches still being mostly size=1.

leah_support: I'll ask MeadowPay if they're ok with top50 prefetch. Also collecting their memory footprint per GPU; if top50 fits we're good.

nate_pricing: If they want prefetch but worry about commit size, offer 2-week trial + 10% credit on any extra nodes we temporarily allocate.

claire_pm: Is sticky routing a viable follow-up? Could reduce cross-GPU misses for repeated prefixes.

ola_runtime: Sticky routing would co-locate a prefix's requests onto the same shard, which increases local cache hits. It's a low-risk toggle but might slightly reduce global packing efficiency. Worth enabling after we validate prefetch.

alex_sales: Good. Plan for the call: show staging A numbers (160ms, 74% hit), propose top50 prefetch in prod for a short smoke window, have pricing offer ready. Leah to confirm memory fit. Claire to own security Q answers.

ops-bot: prod change queued for meadow-ded: prefetch_mode=top_k_prefixes prefetch_k=50 prefetch_ttl=90; requires approval.

ryan_infra: Approving this for the 30m smoke window, will monitor `latency_first_token_ms`, `kv_cache_hit`, and `429_rate`. If we see improved hit rate and median <=200ms we keep for the trial.

leah_support: Customer approved top50 prefetch for a 1-hour trial. Sharing GPU memory stats now.

ops-bot: prod smoke results (10m sample): median_latency_first_token_ms=172 kv_cache_hit_rate=71 429_rate=0.02%

alex_sales: Great. I'll update MeadowPay and proceed with the trial offer. Nate please draft the pricing blurb. Claire please send the security answers. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
